title: Embassy Grand Convention Centre

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: When you want to “wow” prospective clients, treat your hard-working employees to some well-deserved luxury, or host your next big product launch, trust the Embassy team to create a great impression that people will be talking about for years to come. We excel in coordinating and executing large and prominent Corporate Events and Galas, and regularly service clients from the largest companies and philanthropic organizations in Canada. Whether it’s an exciting product launch or your yearly AGM, a major conference with international partners or your company Christmas party, Embassy Grand provides the perfect space for your corporate gathering, at a highly competitive rate. blurb: Based in Brampton ON, Embassy Grand is a leading banquet hall and convention centre for both indoor and outdoor weddings, wedding receptions, corporate events, galas and other events. Our banquet halls can accommodate up to 2,500 guests, is newly renovated and features high ceilings, a large free parking lot and state of the art audiovisual capabilities.
